What Is 21K Gold?

21K gold, also called 21-karat gold, contains approximately 87.5% pure gold. In a 24-part karat system, 21 parts represent gold and the remaining portion consists of other metals used to form the alloy.

This is why 21K has a lower pure-gold content than 24K and 22K but a higher gold content than 18K.

21K Gold Quick Facts

87.5% Approximate pure-gold content of 21K gold.
21K 21 parts gold in a 24-part karat system.
11.664g Approximately one traditional tola.

21K Gold Rate Per Tola in Sargodha

Gold in Pakistan is commonly discussed using the traditional unit called the tola. One tola is approximately 11.664 grams.

When checking a 21K gold per tola Sargodha quotation, confirm that the quoted price is for 21K gold and that you are comparing the same date, purity and weight unit.

Simple conversion: To estimate a per-gram value from a per-tola value, divide the per-tola amount by approximately 11.664.

21K Gold Price Per Gram in Sargodha

The 21K gold per gram Sargodha value is useful when comparing smaller jewellery items such as rings, earrings, pendants and lightweight bracelets.

Remember that "gram" describes weight while "21K" describes purity. Both details are needed when comparing the underlying gold value of an item.

21K vs 24K Gold

One of the most common questions is the difference between 21K and 24K gold. 24K has a higher gold content, while 21K contains approximately 87.5% gold.

Feature 21K 24K
Approx. gold content 87.5% Approximately 99.9%
Karat level 21 parts of 24 24 parts of 24
Common context Jewellery High-purity gold reference

For a broader explanation, read the difference between 21K and 24K gold .

21K vs 22K Gold

22K gold contains approximately 91.6% gold, compared with approximately 87.5% in 21K. Because the gold content is different, the underlying metal value is also different.

When comparing the 21K gold rate Sargodha with 22K, make sure the date, weight and quoted unit are the same.

21K vs 18K Gold

18K gold contains approximately 75% pure gold, while 21K contains approximately 87.5%. These purities should not be compared as though they are the same gold composition.

What Affects the 21K Gold Rate in Sargodha?

The local 21K gold price Sargodha can be influenced by several factors:

  • International gold-market prices.
  • USD to PKR exchange-rate movement.
  • Local supply and demand.
  • Market timing and update time.
  • Local trading conditions.
  • Differences between benchmark and retail transaction pricing.

Why the Final 21K Jewellery Price Can Be Different

A gold-rate reference describes the underlying metal value. The final price of a finished jewellery item can contain additional components.

Net Gold Weight

Ask for the actual net gold weight, particularly when an item contains stones or non-gold components.

Workmanship

Detailed or handmade designs can require more labour and workmanship than simpler designs.

Stone Work

Gemstones and other decorative components may have separate values.

How to Buy 21K Gold Jewellery in Sargodha

  1. Confirm the item's purity.
  2. Ask for the exact weight.
  3. Confirm whether the rate is per gram or per tola.
  4. Ask how the gold value was calculated.
  5. Ask about workmanship or labour charges.
  6. Confirm separate charges for stones or other components.
  7. Request the final payable amount before making payment.

What to Check When Selling 21K Gold

If you are selling an existing 21K jewellery item, its value should not be determined from weight alone.

The purity and net gold weight may need to be assessed before calculating a valuation.

Ask which rate is being applied and how the final amount has been calculated.

What is 21K gold?

What is 21K gold per tola in Sargodha?

What is 21K gold per gram?
